accepted.s: PM GatiShakti National Master Plan was launched on which date?
accepted.x: PM GatiShakti National Master Plan was launched on 13 October 2021.
accepted.tq: Use the precise launch-date distinction.
accepted.sec: Multimodal logistics responses - PM Gati Shakti, freight programmes, MMLPs, freight corridors

accepted.s: Which of the following best describes the PM GatiShakti National Master Plan?
o: A subsidy programme for inland waterways
A scheme exclusively for coastal shipping
accepted.x: PM GatiShakti is a GIS-based platform for integrated infrastructure planning.
accepted.tq: Identify the programme by its defining function.
accepted.sec: Multimodal logistics responses - PM Gati Shakti, freight programmes, MMLPs, freight corridors

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding PM GatiShakti:
1. It brought 16 ministries onto one platform.
2. Its Empowered Group of Secretaries functions under the Cabinet Secretary.
3. The Empowered Group of Secretaries has 23 members.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: PM GatiShakti brought 16 ministries together, and its Empowered Group of Secretaries under the Cabinet Secretary has 23 members.
accepted.tq: Combine institutional, numerical and authority details.
accepted.sec: Multimodal logistics responses - PM Gati Shakti, freight programmes, MMLPs, freight corridors

accepted.s: The Bharatmala programme, launched in 2017, envisages development of approximately how many kilometres of National Highway corridors?
accepted.x: Bharatmala, launched in 2017, covers 34,800 km of National Highway corridors and aims to improve freight and passenger efficiency.
accepted.tq: Test the programme-year and scale together.
accepted.sec: Multimodal logistics responses - PM Gati Shakti, freight programmes, MMLPs, freight corridors

accepted.s: Which one of the following is NOT a pillar of the Sagarmala programme?
accepted.x: Sagarmala has five pillars: port modernisation, port connectivity, port-led industry, coastal communities, and coastal shipping or inland water transport. Dedicated railway electrification is not one of them.
accepted.tq: Find the item outside the named five-pillar framework.
accepted.sec: Multimodal logistics responses - PM Gati Shakti, freight programmes, MMLPs, freight corridors

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about Sagarmala:
1. It includes five major pillars.
2. It comprises more than 800 projects.
3. Its estimated investment is approximately ₹5.8 lakh crore.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Sagarmala is based on five pillars, includes more than 800 projects and involves an estimated investment of about ₹5.8 lakh crore.
accepted.tq: Use the all-inclusive option when all numerical statements are supported.
accepted.sec: Multimodal logistics responses - PM Gati Shakti, freight programmes, MMLPs, freight corridors

accepted.s:
Which of the following correctly matches the GatiShakti rail corridor with its category?
A. Energy-Mineral-Cement
B. Port Connectivity
C. High Traffic Density
o: A, B and C are all categories
Only A and B are categories
Only B and C are categories
Only A and C are categories
accepted.x: The three GatiShakti rail corridor categories are Energy-Mineral-Cement, Port Connectivity and High Traffic Density.
accepted.tq: Check whether all listed categories belong to the same programme.
accepted.sec: Multimodal logistics responses - PM Gati Shakti, freight programmes, MMLPs, freight corridors

accepted.s: The GatiShakti rail corridors comprise how many projects involving an estimated outlay of ₹11.17 lakh crore?
accepted.x: The GatiShakti rail corridor programme comprises 434 projects with an estimated cost of ₹11.17 lakh crore.
accepted.tq: Distinguish closely spaced project counts.
accepted.sec: Multimodal logistics responses - PM Gati Shakti, freight programmes, MMLPs, freight corridors

accepted.s: How many Multimodal Logistics Parks are planned, with Jogighopa in Assam cited as an example?

accepted.tq: Link the example location with the programme count.
accepted.sec: Multimodal logistics responses - PM Gati Shakti, freight programmes, MMLPs, freight corridors

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about the Dedicated Freight Corridors:
1. The total operational length is 2,843 km.
2. The Eastern DFC runs from Ludhiana to Sonnagar.
3. The Western DFC runs from Dadri to JNPT.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The full 2,843 km is operational; the Eastern DFC connects Ludhiana with Sonnagar and the Western DFC connects Dadri with JNPT.
accepted.tq: Combine total length with terminal-city identification.
accepted.sec: Multimodal logistics responses - PM Gati Shakti, freight programmes, MMLPs, freight corridors

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes the funding pattern of the two principal Dedicated Freight Corridors?
accepted.x: The 1,337-km Eastern DFC is World Bank-funded, while the 1,506-km Western DFC is JICA-funded.
accepted.tq: Use the funding-agency comparison to separate similar corridors.
accepted.sec: Multimodal logistics responses - PM Gati Shakti, freight programmes, MMLPs, freight corridors

accepted.s: Which new Dedicated Freight Corridor was announced in the Union Budget 2026–27?
accepted.x: The Dankuni–Surat Dedicated Freight Corridor was announced in the Budget 2026–27.
accepted.tq: Identify the new proposal rather than an existing corridor.
accepted.sec: Multimodal logistics responses - PM Gati Shakti, freight programmes, MMLPs, freight corridors

accepted.s: The Trans-Siberian Railway connects which two terminal cities?
accepted.x: The Trans-Siberian Railway runs between Moscow and Vladivostok.
accepted.tq: Recall the terminal-city pair of a major transcontinental railway.
accepted.sec: Transcontinental railways → terminal cities

accepted.s:
Which one of the following is correctly matched?
A. Canadian Pacific — Halifax–Vancouver
B. Union Pacific — New York–San Francisco
C. Orient Express — Paris–Istanbul
D. Trans-Andean — Buenos Aires–Valparaiso
accepted.x: All four pairs are correct: Canadian Pacific links Halifax and Vancouver, Union Pacific links New York and San Francisco, Orient Express links Paris and Istanbul, and Trans-Andean links Buenos Aires and Valparaiso.
accepted.tq: Start with sure terminal pairs and verify the complete set.
accepted.sec: Transcontinental railways → terminal cities

accepted.s: Which railway passes through Vienna, Budapest and Bucharest?
accepted.x: The Orient Express runs between Paris and Istanbul through Vienna, Budapest and Bucharest.
accepted.tq: Identify a railway from its intermediate cities.
accepted.sec: Transcontinental railways → terminal cities

accepted.s: The Trans-Andean Railway crosses the Andes through which pass?
accepted.x: The Trans-Andean Railway crosses the Andes through the Uspallata Pass.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between geographically similar passes.
accepted.sec: Transcontinental railways → terminal cities

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Trans-Siberian Railway is approximately 9,300 km long.
2. It is the longest railway line in the world.
3. It crosses the Ural Mountains.
Which of the statements given above are correct?

accepted.s: Rail links carrying cement, granite and minerals primarily serve which group of Andhra Pradesh ports?

accepted.s: Why do industrial nodes such as Kopparthy and Orvakal continue to depend substantially on roads?
o: Their last-mile rail links are incomplete.
Their ports have been permanently closed.
They are connected only to inland waterways.
They are located outside Andhra Pradesh.
accepted.x: The last-mile rail links to Kopparthy and Orvakal are incomplete, increasing dependence on road transport.
accepted.tq: Apply the connectivity-gap concept to an industrial-node scenario.
accepted.sec: Port-hinterland rail links - AP ports, Rayalaseema-coast links, tribal area roads

accepted.s: The Guntakal–Ballari third and fourth railway lines are intended to improve connectivity between Rayalaseema and which of the following?
o: Maharashtra, Gujarat, Visakhapatnam and Kochi ports
Tamil Nadu, Kerala, Gangavaram and Kandla ports
Telangana, Odisha, Kakinada and Chennai ports
Karnataka, Goa, Krishnapatnam and Ramayapatnam ports
accepted.x: The project connects Rayalaseema with Karnataka and Goa and improves links to Krishnapatnam and Ramayapatnam ports.
accepted.tq: Use the full regional-connectivity chain rather than a single endpoint.
accepted.sec: Port-hinterland rail links - AP ports, Rayalaseema-coast links, tribal area roads

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about the Guntakal–Ballari third and fourth lines:

2. It is expected to add 16.22 MTPA capacity.
3. Its target completion is 2028–29.
